title: Lovász Conjecture
exact_target: Can all vertices of every finite connected vertex-transitive graph be visited exactly once along one path?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1420 (GRAPH-033). CC BY 4.0.

Carla Groenland, Sean Longbrake, Raphael Steiner, Jérémie Turcotte and Liana Yepremyan, Longest Cycles in Vertex-Transitive and Highly Connected Graphs, arXiv:2408.04618v2 (2025), Section 1, page 2, Lovász’s 1969 Hamiltonian-path question.
